info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector :Analyze Conversations API
Microsoft Azure Submit Analysis Job For Conversations

items.docs: Submit a collection of conversations for analysis. Specify one or more unique tasks to be executed.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Get Analysis Status And Results

items.docs: Get the status of an analysis job. A job may consist of one or more tasks. Once all tasks are succeeded, the job will transition to the succeeded state and results will be available for each task.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Cancel A Long Running Text Analysis Conversations Job

items.docs: Cancel a long-running Text Analysis conversations job.
